_doc: DATA_RUNBOOK §173 (2026-09-26, user-approved task 2): Nifty-500 rights issues as ABSOLUTE bar-exact targets. rows = [symbol, ex trading day, target factor, NSE raw close ratio across that bar]. target = min(1, TERP/cum), TERP = (A*cum + B*issue)/(A+B) for 'Rights B:A', issue = face value AT THE EVENT + premium ('@ Par Rs X' = X), face value = NSE EQUITY_L.csv walked back through every later FV split/consolidation on NSE's feed (the feed's faceVal is the CURRENT FV), cum = NSE's raw close the session before the ex trading day. update_sf_data.reconcile_rights measures the factor baked at each bar (raw ratio / stored ratio) and rescales the pre-bar history to the target (idempotent, rounding-aware tolerance). Rows with target 1.0 on an ordinary session UNDO a fake step an old late-dated row baked there. Any MANUAL_RIGHTS / rights_terp.json row within 30 days of a row here is superseded (not applied). 'provenance' lists every N500 rights row on NSE's feed 2006-2026 incl. the ones NOT computed (partly paid, warrants, NCD, no price) or EXCLUDED because the tape contradicts the filed terms - those keep whatever they had. | 2026-09-26 §179: LAKSHVILAS 2014-07-25 (Rights 5:6) added — issue price Rs 50 (FV 10 + premium 40) read from NSE's own corporate announcement of 16-Jul-2014 (the feed row states no price). | 2026-09-26 §179: WHEELS 2014-02-13 TERP on the ACTUAL shares issued (promoters forwent — SEBI MPS rights), ALOKINDS 2013 row keyed to era key ALOKTEXT; CHEMPLASTS 2009 / NEULANDLAB 2012 statuses resolved. | 2026-09-28 §206: SCOPE WIDENED (user) to the NSE SME board + main-board rights 2026 no ledger covered: 33 rows added (SME feed index=sme 2013-2026: 36 rights rows, 25 targets incl. 2 split-inference steps corrected [MPEL 2026-08-31, DHARIWAL 2026-02-27]; main board 2026: 8 targets). FV for SME rows = the SME feed row's faceVal (at-event: BTML/ABINFRA rows keep FV 10 across their later splits). Held (EXCLUDED/NOT_COMPUTED, see provenance board=sme/equities): COOLCAPS, IEML, ROCKINGDCE, RCDL, SUNREST x2, DESTINY x2, SADHNANIQ, GANGAFORGE, QUINT. | 2026-09-29 §179c: THOMASCOOK 2008-12-19 rights (NSE feed spelling 'Rhgt' missed by the §173 scan; a full rescan with Rights/Rght/Rhgt/Rgt/Rts found no other N500 miss). §179d (2026-09-29): +16 rows found by the quantmac round-2 cell-by-cell recheck — feed spellings the §173 scan missed ("Rht", "Rhs", "Rhts", a rights row inside an AGM/dividend row, "9 Ccds For Every 40") and rows §173 left NOT_COMPUTED (partly paid, rights with warrants/NCDs/DVR, no price on the feed) whose terms were read from the NSE/BSE filings: equity parts at the filed price; partly paid at the full price (as RELIANCE 2020); compulsorily convertible debentures/bonds as equity at the conversion price (the user's TRENT CCPS policy A); warrants and pure debt not priced in. Cum/ex closes 2006-07 from NSE cm bhavcopies.
